entities.name: Core of Paradise
entities.description: A massive hollow inverted sphere at the core of Ixalan with a sun, Chimil, at its center; the oldest place on Ixalan, ruled by the Oltec.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane whose core is the Core of Paradise.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: The only surviving civilization of the Core and ancestors of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The star at the center of the Core, worshiped by the Oltec as creator of humanity and mother of the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The last survivor of the Fourth People who became godlike, slew a Deep God, started the Whispering War, was imprisoned, and later freed.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: The children of Chimil born at the dawn of the Fifth Age.

entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: A Deep God of fury and strength who defeats and imprisons Aclazotz.

entities.name: Ojer Taq
entities.description: A Deep God, elder sibling of Axonil, whom Aclazotz tries to kill.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: The first humans of Ixalan, who awoke inside the Core under Chimil.

entities.name: Tan Jolom
entities.description: The first Komon Winaq to circumnavigate the Core, who became an Echo and left a door open to the afterlife.

entities.name: Whispering War
entities.description: The war in which Aclazotz's cults fought the Komon until the Deep Gods intervened.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: Interplanar colonizers who built a shell around Chimil and ruled the Core in darkness.

entities.name: Night War
entities.description: The war that expelled the Fomori from the Core.

entities.name: Olanem Teq
entities.description: A heroic leader of the resistance against the colonizers from Oq'tinimit.

entities.name: Oteclan
entities.description: The capital city of the Oltec, on the shores of Lake Wachibal.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: A fungal hivemind that attacked the Oltec after an outbreak spread through the caverns.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The faction that entered the Core and freed Aclazotz.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire descended from Komon Winaq who migrated to the plane's surface.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that spared the Core but not the plane's surface.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: The emperor's sister who plots to depose her brother Atlacan to prevent war.

entities.name: Atlacan
entities.description: The bellicose emperor of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: An admiral who agrees to support the two factions in exchange for a Brazen Coalition state.

events.summary: Aclazotz, last of the Fourth People, slaughters the others out of fear of death and becomes godlike.
events.quote: His fear of death drove him to become godlike

events.summary: Aclazotz slays the last Deep God before he can emerge, eating him and taking his place.
events.quote: Before the last God could emerge, Aclazotz slew him, eating him and taking his place.

events.summary: Tan Jolom completes a circumnavigation of the Core and confirms that the world is a sphere around a star.
events.quote: Tan Jolom was the first of the Komon Winaq to complete a circumnavigation of the Core

events.summary: Tan Jolom becomes an Echo and departs for the afterlife, leaving a door open.
events.quote: So, he became an Echo and departed for the afterlife

events.summary: Aclazotz hardens the veil between life and death and feeds on fear, promising followers eternal life.
events.quote: he hardened the gossamer veil between life and death

events.summary: Axonil leads a thousand champions against Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes and imprisons him, ending the Whispering War.
events.quote: the god of fury and strength tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and imprisoned him

events.summary: The Fomori arrive and establish dominion over the Core, completing a shell around Chimil that plunges the Core into darkness.
events.quote: the Fomori completed their shell around Chimil, and total darkness fell throughout the Core

events.summary: Olanem Teq leads the resistance from Oq'tinimit against the colonizers.
events.quote: From the city of Oq'tinimit, Teq led the resistance

events.summary: Chimil shatters the shards of her cage, blasting away the Fomori and creating the first angels of Ixalan.
The Night War ends with the Fomori expelled from the Core.
events.quote: The war ended with the Fomori expelled from the Core

events.summary: A fungal outbreak at Topizielo spreads through the caverns, giving rise to the mycoids, and the Core is sealed.
events.quote: Those who remained in the caverns sealed all entrances to the Core to protect it from the spread of the mycoids.

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
events.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz , who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

events.summary: Caztaca plots to depose her brother Atlacan, and Beckett Brass agrees to support two factions in exchange for a Brazen Coalition state.
events.quote: Hoping to prevent war, the emperor's sister Caztaca Huicintli plotted to depose her bellicose brother Atlacan
